import sys, os, hashlib; sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
from dealroom_sign import placement
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
print(placement.VERSION, hashlib.sha256(open(placement.__file__, 'rb').read()).hexdigest()[:8])
rc = R24.rc; X = 72
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))
fleet = [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X, 290), (310, 'Date:', True, X, 290)]
AFF = [(520, 'HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', False, X), (560, 'By:', True, X, 290), (600, 'Date:', True, X, 290)]
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    # r28 H-1 repro (verbatim shapes) + variants named in the r28 review
    for sig in ('Signature:', '/s/ Pat Smith', 'DocuSign Envelope ID: 4F2A-11', None):
        for head in ('For and on behalf of the Recipient', None):
            for x, aff in ((340, False), (X, True)):
                own = ([(340, head, False, x)] if head else []) + ([(370, sig, False, x)] if sig else []) + [(382, 'Name: Pat Smith', False, x), (394, 'Title: CEO', False, x)]
                pdf = rc.pages_pdf([list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), fleet + own + (AFF if aff else [])])
                mo = Mock(); r = placement.place(pdf, [dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)], model_client=mo)
                r2 = in_process(placement, pdf, [dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)], Mock())
                print('H-1', sig, '|', head, '| x', x, 'aff', aff, '|', r['status'], r['reason_code'], len(r['fields']), 'model', mo.call_count, 'worker==inproc', r == r2)
    # r27 B-1 five worker shapes (r28 call 14)
    def rows(cap, name, tail):
        return [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X), (300, 'Date:', True, X),
                (340, 'For and on behalf of the Recipient', False, X), (370, cap, True, X), (382, name, False, X), tail,
                (520, 'HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', False, X), (560, 'By:', True, X), (600, 'Date:', True, X)]
    for name, rs in [('Executed by:', rows('Executed by:', 'Name: Pat Smith', (394, 'Title: CEO', False, X))),
                     ('Authorised signatory:', rows('Authorised signatory:', 'Name: Pat Smith', (420, 'Title:', True, X))),
                     ('Signatory: Nom', rows('Signatory:', 'Nom: Pat Smith', (420, 'Date:', True, X))),
                     ('Firma: bare', rows('Firma:', 'Pat Smith', (420, 'Date:', True, X))),
                     ('Unterschrift: Fecha', rows('Unterschrift:', 'Name: Pat Smith', (420, 'Fecha:', True, X)))]:
        pdf = rc.pages_pdf([list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), rs]); ppl = [dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)]
        mo = Mock(); r = placement.place(pdf, ppl, model_client=mo)
        print('B-1', name, '|', r['status'], r['reason_code'], len(r['fields']), 'model', mo.call_count, 'worker==inproc', r == in_process(placement, pdf, ppl, Mock()))
print('http', http.call_count)
